A.domain: Subtraction of fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Align unlike denominators
skills.definition: Find a common denominator and convert fraction parts to equivalent fractions before subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution finds an LCD or common denominator for unlike denominators.
Tag when one or both fractions are converted to equivalent fractions with the common denominator.
Tag for unlike-denominator fraction subtraction within either simple fractions or mixed numbers.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is needed.
Do not tag for rewriting whole numbers or mixed numbers without changing fraction denominators.
Do not tag for reducing the final answer after subtraction.

skills.name: Standardize number forms
skills.definition: Rewrite operands into compatible whole-number, fraction, or mixed-number form before performing subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when an improper fractional part in a mixed number is normalized into a proper mixed-number form.
Tag when a whole number is rewritten with a zero fractional part using a needed denominator.
Tag when a fraction is rewritten as a mixed number with zero whole part to align with another mixed number.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for finding an LCD or converting unlike denominators to equivalent fractions.
Do not tag for the actual subtraction of whole or fraction parts.
Do not tag for combining the final whole and fractional parts after subtraction.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract numerators of like-denominator fractions and subtract whole-number parts when quantities are aligned.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when like-denominator fraction parts are subtracted by subtracting numerators.
Tag when whole-number parts of mixed numbers are subtracted separately.
Tag when subtraction produces a zero or negative fractional part before any borrowing or simplification.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for converting unlike denominators before subtraction.
Do not tag for borrowing or regrouping after a negative fractional part appears.
Do not tag for reducing or formatting the final answer.

skills.name: Regroup and finalize
skills.definition: Adjust an intermediate result into a valid final form by borrowing when needed, simplifying fractions, eliminating zero parts, or combining whole and fractional parts.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when one whole is borrowed to resolve a negative fractional part.
Tag when a fraction is simplified or reduced to lowest terms.
Tag when a zero fractional part is simplified to an integer.
Tag when whole and fractional parts are combined into the final mixed number or proper fraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for the initial rewriting of operands before subtraction.
Do not tag for finding a common denominator before subtraction.
Do not tag for the initial component subtraction that creates the intermediate result.

B.domain: Subtraction of fractions, improper fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Find a least common denominator and convert fractional parts to equivalent fractions with that denominator before subtracting.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the operands have unlike denominators and the solution finds an LCD or common denominator.
Tag when one or both fractions are converted to equivalent fractions before subtraction.
Tag for unlike-denominator fraction subtraction and unlike-denominator mixed-number fractional parts.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when the fractions already have the same denominator and no denominator conversion is needed.
Do not tag for simplifying a fraction after subtraction.
Do not tag for rewriting a whole number as a mixed number with a zero fraction unless an LCD conversion is also performed.

skills.name: Subtract fractional parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with a common denominator by subtracting numerators and express the fractional result in simplified or zero form when needed.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution subtracts numerators over a shared denominator.
Tag when mixed-number fraction parts are subtracted after denominators are aligned or already equal.
Tag when the fractional result is simplified, reduced, or converted from a zero fraction to 0.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for finding the LCD or converting to equivalent denominators before the subtraction.
Do not tag for subtracting whole-number parts of mixed numbers.
Do not tag for borrowing/regrouping from the whole-number part, even though fraction subtraction may occur within that process.

skills.name: Use mixed-number structure
skills.definition: Represent operands in compatible mixed-number form, subtract whole-number components, and combine whole and fractional components into the final mixed-number or integer result.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a whole number or proper fraction is rewritten as a mixed number with a zero fractional or whole component.
Tag when an improper fractional part inside a mixed number is normalized into a proper mixed-number form.
Tag when the solution subtracts whole-number parts separately from fractional parts.
Tag when the solution combines the whole-number and fractional results into a final mixed number, fraction, or integer.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for fraction-only subtraction with no mixed-number or whole-number component.
Do not tag for LCD conversion between unlike fractional parts.
Do not tag for the borrowing/regrouping adjustment when the fractional subtraction is negative; tag that separately.

skills.name: Borrow for subtraction
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as an equivalent fractional unit when the fractional part of a mixed-number subtraction would be negative.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the fractional subtraction produces a negative fractional part and the solution borrows 1 from the whole-number difference.
Tag when a whole is converted into denominator-over-denominator form, such as 5/5, 10/10, or 24/24, to complete the fractional subtraction.
Tag when the whole-number result is reduced by 1 as part of mixed-number regrouping.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when the fractional part can be subtracted directly without becoming negative.
Do not tag for ordinary simplification or reduction of a fraction.
Do not tag for normalizing an improper fractional part before subtraction unless a borrowing step is also performed.

C.domain: Subtraction of fractions, whole numbers, and mixed numbers with simplification

skills.name: Prepare compatible forms
skills.definition: Rewrite operands into equivalent forms that are ready for component-wise subtraction, such as common-denominator fractions, mixed numbers with zero fractional parts, or normalized mixed numbers.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution finds an LCD and converts one or both fractions to equivalent fractions with a common denominator.
Tag when a whole number or proper fraction is rewritten as a mixed-number form with a zero whole or zero fractional part.
Tag when a mixed number with an improper fractional part is normalized by carrying excess fractional units into the whole-number part.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when the operands already have compatible denominators and no rewriting is performed.
Do not tag for the actual subtraction of whole parts or numerators after rewriting is complete.
Do not tag for borrowing/regrouping caused by a negative fractional difference.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract like-denominator fractional parts by subtracting numerators and, for mixed numbers, subtract corresponding whole-number parts.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution subtracts numerators over a shared denominator.
Tag when the solution separately subtracts whole-number parts and fractional parts of mixed numbers.
Tag when a zero or negative fractional difference is first produced before any regrouping or simplification.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for finding a common denominator or converting to equivalent fractions.
Do not tag for the borrowing step that fixes a negative fractional part.
Do not tag for reducing fractions or combining the final mixed-number answer.

skills.name: Regroup by borrowing
skills.definition: When the fractional part of the minuend is smaller than the fractional part of the subtrahend, borrow one whole unit and convert it into a denominator-over-denominator fraction before subtracting.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution identifies or responds to a negative fractional difference in a mixed-number subtraction.
Tag when one whole is subtracted from the whole-number result and added to the fractional part as a full fractional unit such as 5/5, 10/10, or 24/24.
Tag when borrowing is used after rewriting a whole number with a zero fractional part.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when the fractional part can be subtracted directly without becoming negative.
Do not tag for normalizing an improper fractional part before subtraction.
Do not tag for simplifying or combining the answer after borrowing is complete.

skills.name: Finalize simplified answer
skills.definition: Express the result in an acceptable final form by reducing fractions, simplifying zero fractional parts, and combining whole and fractional parts when needed.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution reduces a fraction to lowest terms.
Tag when a zero fraction such as 0/2 or 0/3 is simplified to 0 or omitted from a mixed number.
Tag when whole and fractional results are combined into a final mixed number, whole number, or proper fraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for raw numerator subtraction or whole-number subtraction.
Do not tag for finding common denominators or equivalent fractions.
Do not tag for borrowing/regrouping before the final expression is formed.
